corrections.detail: call_date() anchored the date regex at ^ while names begin with an ordinal ('01. 10-5-2023 ...'). Every 2023-2025 batch lost its date.
Month folder names repeat across years. Keying folders by name is ambiguous.
corrections.fix: folders key on HANDLE; the label is derived from the call's own date, which is authoritative. The MEGA folder is retained as source_folder for traceability and cross-checked, never trusted for the label.

corrections.detail: 8 file names carry U+00D4 U+00C7 U+00F6 where an em-dash belongs. UTF-8 was decoded as cp850 in the capture pipeline.
corrections.evidence_for_cp850: 5 candidate reversals were tested; cp850 -> utf-8 is the only one that lands on a real dash. cp1252 and latin-1 raise UnicodeDecodeError, cp437 raises UnicodeEncodeError, mac-roman yields no dash. Applied only when that check passes, never blind.
corrections.blast_radius: 8 names of 709 rows. 653 `title` attributes also carry mojibake (non-breaking space as U+252C U+00E1) but the manifest parses only sizes out of those, which survived.

corrections.detail: I previously reported that 'three independent enumerations agree exactly (656.90 h, 183.92 GB)' as validation. They shared the same grouping logic, so agreement confirmed the flaw was applied consistently, not that it was absent. This is now withdrawn.

manifest: content-os/probe/out/manifest-v3.json - 247 units, each with minted per-file URL, MP3-preferred selection, every unselected file recorded as an alternate. An assertion fails the build if any media file is unaccounted for.
definition_of_done_met: the merged call resolves to exactly one unit; the alternates assertion passes; and the MP3 and MP4 of the merged call transcribe to near-identical output (37027w/spk22 vs 36963w/spk21), confirming same session and confirming the remux is lossless.
